name: Birdwatcher
source:
You find yourself in a dark Lovecraftian forest where birds haven't been seen for days, and your only companion is a strange speech-to-text device gifted to you by your long-deceased father.

[From [url=https://galya-timel.itch.io/birdwatcher]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你发现自己身处洛夫克拉夫特式的黑暗森林中，那里已经好几天没有看到鸟儿了，你唯一的伴侣是你已故父亲送给你的一个奇怪的语音转文本设备。

[来自[url=https://galya-timel.itch.io/birdwatcher]Itch.io[/url]]
